crossRefs.note: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and…
Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak…
I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

people.name: Judas
people.line: A prophet and leader in the Jerusalem church

people.name: Silas
people.line: Prominent member of the Jerusalem church, companion of Paul.

translations.web: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.
translations.bsb: Therefore we are sending Judas and Silas to tell you in person the same things we are writing.
translations.kjv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
translations.asv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves also shall tell you the same things by word of mouth.
